metadata.title: Pavois Effective-Configuration Hardening Baseline
metadata.remarks: A Linux hardening baseline expressed as assertions on the EFFECTIVE running configuration — sshd -T, sysctl, auditctl -l, systemctl show — not on configuration files. It therefore audits what is actually applied (Includes, drop-ins, kernel defaults resolved), exactly where file-based scanners are blind. Each control has a stable OS-neutral id and maps to CIS, ANSSI-BP-028, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-171, PCI-DSS and DISA STIG — the standard is a VIEW, never a duplicated rule.

controls.title: Ensure the Default Bash Umask is Set Correctly (077)

props.name: check
props.value:
m = {'bp28'=>'0077','cis'=>'0027'}.fetch(input('pavois_standard', value: '_default'), '0077')
describe command("v=$(grep -hiE '^[[:space:]]*umask[[:space:]]+[0-7]+' /etc/bash.bashrc 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-7]+' | tail -1); { [ -n \"$v\" ] && [ $((0$v & #{m})) -eq $((#{m})) ] && echo ok; } || echo ko") do
  its('stdout.strip') { should eq 'ok' }
end

parts.name: statement

props.name: check

m = {'bp28'=>'0077','cis'=>'0027'}.fetch(input('pavois_standard', value: '_default'), '0077')
describe command("v=$(grep -hiE '^[[:space:]]*umask[[:space:]]+[0-7]+' /etc/profile /etc/profile.d/*.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-7]+' | tail -1); { [ -n \"$v\" ] && [ $((0$v & #{m})) -eq $((#{m})) ] && echo ok; } || echo ko") do
  its('stdout.strip') { should eq 'ok' }
end
